import json
import pytest
from scripts import opencode_project as native

def test_multiple_sessions_rejected():
    events = [
        {"type":"step_start"},
        {"type":"text", "text":"x"},
        {"type":"step_finish", "reason":"stop"},
    ]
    stream = "\n".join(json.dumps({**e, "sessionID":sid}) for sid in ("ses_1", "ses_2") for e in events)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        native._reply(stream)

def test_valid_cache_is_reused(tmp_path):
